name: Hexagon Nutrition
description: Hexagon Nutrition is India's leading clinical and sports nutrition company. They manufacture protein supplements, clinical nutrition products (for hospitals), and maternal nutrition. The company supplies to 60+ countries and owns brands like Pureprotein and Hexagrow. They are the largest contract manufacturer of nutritional supplements in India.
purpose: Expansion of manufacturing capacity at Nashik plant, new product R&D, international market expansion (Africa, SEA), brand building, and working capital requirements.

name: CMR Green Technologies
description: CMR Green Technologies is a renewable energy EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) company specializing in solar power plants, wind energy projects, and green hydrogen. They execute utility-scale solar projects for government and private clients. The company has completed 2.5 GW of solar installations across 12 states and has a current order book of ₹2,400 Cr.
purpose: Execution of existing order book, expansion into green hydrogen segment, setting up solar module manufacturing unit (500 MW capacity), and debt repayment.

name: Genxai Analytics
description: Genxai Analytics provides AI/ML-based data analytics solutions to mid-size enterprises. Their core product is an analytics platform that helps companies analyze customer behavior, predict churn, and optimize marketing spend. They serve clients in BFSI, e-commerce, and healthcare sectors with 35+ enterprise customers.
purpose: Product development (NLP and computer vision modules), hiring data scientists, sales team expansion, and cloud infrastructure investments.

name: Vahh Chemicals
description: Vahh Chemicals manufactures specialty chemicals and intermediates used in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and dye industries. They operate a single manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar GIDC, Gujarat. Revenue has been inconsistent due to raw material price volatility and dependency on a few large customers.
purpose: Capacity expansion of existing plant, setting up effluent treatment facility, repayment of term loans, and working capital.

name: Bagmane Prime Office
description: Bagmane Prime Office is a REIT (Real Estate Investment Trust) that owns and manages premium Grade A office spaces in Bangalore's tech corridors. The portfolio includes 15 million sq ft of office space leased to top IT companies including Microsoft, Cisco, Wells Fargo, and Goldman Sachs. Occupancy rate is 93% with weighted average lease expiry of 5.2 years.
purpose: Acquisition of additional office assets from sponsor (Bagmane Group), debt reduction, and distribution to unitholders.

name: OnEMI Technology Solutions
description: OnEMI Technology Solutions operates 'Kissht', one of India's largest Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and personal loan platforms. They provide instant credit to underserved consumers using AI-based credit scoring. The platform has 25M+ registered users, ₹8,000 Cr annual disbursement, and partners with 5,000+ merchants. They are RBI-registered NBFC.
purpose: Augmenting capital base for loan book growth, technology infrastructure, regulatory compliance reserves, and brand marketing.

name: UHM Vacation
description: UHM Vacation provides vacation ownership (timeshare) and holiday membership plans. They operate resorts and tie-ups with hotels across India for their members. The company targets middle-income families seeking affordable holiday packages.
purpose: Resort property acquisition, marketing expenses, and working capital.
